verses.original: כִּֽי־ וְנֶ֗פֶשׁ תַקְרִ֞יב קָרְבַּ֤ן מִנְחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ סֹ֖לֶת יִהְיֶ֣ה וְיָצַ֤ק שֶׁ֔מֶן עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ וְנָתַ֥ן לְבֹנָֽה׃ עָלֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: kî- wə·ne·p̄eš ṯaq·rîḇ qā·rə·ban min·ḥāh Yah·weh qā·rə·bā·nōw sō·leṯ yih·yeh wə·yā·ṣaq še·men ‘ā·le·hā wə·nā·ṯan lə·ḇō·nāh ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: When anyone brings a grain offering . . . to the LORD his offering must consist of fine flour . . . He is to pour olive oil on it put frankincense on it

verses.original: וֶֽהֱבִיאָ֗הּ אֶל־ אַהֲרֹן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִים֒ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ וְקָמַ֨ץ מִשָּׁ֜ם מְלֹ֣א קֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסָּלְתָּהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אַזְכָּרָתָהּ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: we·hĕ·ḇî·’āh ’el- ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·qā·maṣ miš·šām mə·lō qum·ṣōw mis·sā·lə·tāh ū·miš·šam·nāh ‘al kāl- lə·ḇō·nā·ṯāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests The priest - shall take a handful . . . . . . . . . of the flour and oil together with all the frankincense and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ min- ham·min·ḥāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons it is a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תַקְרִ֛ב קָרְבַּ֥ן מִנְחָ֖ה מַאֲפֵ֣ה תַנּ֑וּר סֹ֣לֶת מַצֹּת֙ חַלּ֤וֹת בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן מַצּ֖וֹת וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מְשֻׁחִ֥ים בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯaq·riḇ qā·rə·ban min·ḥāh ma·’ă·p̄êh ṯan·nūr sō·leṯ maṣ·ṣōṯ ḥal·lō·wṯ bə·lū·lōṯ baš·še·men maṣ·ṣō·wṯ ū·rə·qî·qê mə·šu·ḥîm baš·šā·men
verses.literal: Now if you bring an offering of grain . . . baked in an oven it must consist of fine flour either unleavened cakes mixed with oil or unleavened wafers coated with oil

verses.original: וְאִם־ קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ מִנְחָ֥ה עַל־ הַֽמַּחֲבַ֖ת תִהְיֶֽה׃ מַצָּ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- qā·rə·bā·ne·ḵā min·ḥāh ‘al- ham·ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ ṯih·yeh maṣ·ṣāh sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men
verses.literal: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil

verses.original: פָּת֤וֹת אֹתָהּ֙ פִּתִּ֔ים וְיָצַקְתָּ֥ שָׁ֑מֶן עָלֶ֖יהָ הִֽוא׃ס מִנְחָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: pā·ṯō·wṯ ’ō·ṯāh pit·tîm wə·yā·ṣaq·tā šā·men ‘ā·le·hā hî min·ḥāh
verses.literal: Crumble it - - and pour oil on it it is a grain offering

verses.original: וְאִם־ קָרְבָּנֶ֑ךָ מִנְחַ֥ת מַרְחֶ֖שֶׁת תֵּעָשֶֽׂה׃ סֹ֥לֶת בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- qā·rə·bā·ne·ḵā min·ḥaṯ mar·ḥe·šeṯ tê·‘ā·śeh sō·leṯ baš·še·men
verses.literal: If your offering is a grain offering [cooked] in a pan it must consist of fine flour with oil

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֣ אֶת־ לַיהוָ֑ה הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה מֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִגִּישָׁ֖הּ אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ham·min·ḥāh ’ă·šer yê·‘ā·śeh mê·’êl·leh wə·hiq·rî·ḇāh ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·hig·gî·šāh ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: When you bring - to the LORD the grain offering - made in any of these ways it is to be presented to the priest and he shall take it to the altar

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וְהֵרִ֨ים אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת־ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה אִשֵּׁ֛ה נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·hê·rîm ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh min- ham·min·ḥāh ’eṯ- wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ’iš·šêh nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to remove the memorial portion from the grain offering - and burn it on the altar as a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֙רֶת֙ מִן־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ min- ham·min·ḥāh lə·’a·hă·rōn ū·lə·ḇā·nāw qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons it is a most holy part of the food offerings to the LORD

verses.original: כָּל־ לֹ֥א הַמִּנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּקְרִ֙יבוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה תֵעָשֶׂ֖ה חָמֵ֑ץ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ תַקְטִ֧ירוּ מִמֶּ֛נּוּ כָל־ שְׂאֹר֙ וְכָל־ דְּבַ֔שׁ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- lō ham·min·ḥāh ’ă·šer taq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh ṯê·‘ā·śeh ḥā·mêṣ kî lō- ṯaq·ṭî·rū mim·men·nū ḵāl śə·’ōr wə·ḵāl də·ḇaš ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: No . . . grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven for you are not to burn . . . any leaven . . . or honey as a food offering to the LORD

verses.original: תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה קָרְבַּ֥ן רֵאשִׁ֛ית לֹא־ יַעֲל֖וּ וְאֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ נִיחֹֽחַ׃ לְרֵ֥יחַ
verses.transliteration: taq·rî·ḇū ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh qā·rə·ban rê·šîṯ lō- ya·‘ă·lū wə·’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ
verses.literal: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits but they must not go up on the altar as a pleasing aroma

verses.original: תִּמְלָח֒ וְכָל־ קָרְבַּ֣ן מִנְחָתְךָ֮ בַּמֶּ֣לַח וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֗ית מֶ֚לַח בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מֵעַ֖ל מִנְחָתֶ֑ךָ תַּקְרִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃ס עַ֥ל כָּל־ קָרְבָּנְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: tim·lāḥ wə·ḵāl qā·rə·ban min·ḥā·ṯə·ḵā bam·me·laḥ wə·lō ṯaš·bîṯ me·laḥ bə·rîṯ ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mê·‘al min·ḥā·ṯe·ḵā taq·rîḇ me·laḥ ‘al kāl- qā·rə·bā·nə·ḵā
verses.literal: And you shall season each of your grain offerings . . . with salt You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering you are to add salt to each of your offerings

verses.original: וְאִם־ תַּקְרִ֛יב מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה תַּקְרִ֕יב אֵ֖ת גֶּ֣רֶשׂ אָבִ֞יב כַּרְמֶ֔ל קָל֤וּי בָּאֵשׁ֙ מִנְחַ֥ת בִּכּוּרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- taq·rîḇ min·ḥaṯ bik·kū·rîm Yah·weh taq·rîḇ ’êṯ ge·reś ’ā·ḇîḇ kar·mel qā·lui bā·’êš min·ḥaṯ bik·kū·re·ḵā
verses.literal: If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD you shall offer - crushed heads of new grain . . . roasted on the fire - -

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ עָלֶ֖יהָ לְבֹנָ֑ה עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ הִֽוא׃ מִנְחָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā še·men wə·śam·tā ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḇō·nāh ‘ā·le·hā hî min·ḥāh
verses.literal: And you are to put oil . . . . . . and frankincense on it it is a grain offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ וְהִקְטִ֨יר אַזְכָּרָתָ֗הּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ עַ֖ל כָּל־ לְבֹנָתָ֑הּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·hiq·ṭîr ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh mig·gir·śāh ū·miš·šam·nāh ‘al kāl- lə·ḇō·nā·ṯāh ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest - shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil together with all its frankincense as a food offering to the LORD
